preregistered_questions: How many baseline creature identities lose potential access to Rakdos cost reduction if the challenger replaces it, including commander recasts?
What generic reductions are possible for Abaddon and Neheb at 0, 1, 3 and 9 same-turn opponent life lost, preserving colored requirements and commander tax?
Does Rakdos affect Assault's noncreature casting or five-mana activated ability?
Do the documented life-loss reset, gain-back and source-presence conditions change the arithmetic?
test_conditions: Cost-reduction arithmetic only; assume Rakdos already legally cast, resolved and remains controlled
Never treat casting discount as a mana source or physical access probability
Reduce generic mana, including commander tax; never reduce colored pips
Apply cost increases before Rakdos reduction
Turn-total opponent life lost accumulates irrespective of life gain
Rakdos cannot discount itself before it enters play
Assault is an enchantment and its ability is activated; neither is a creature spell
Review baseline creature inventory from frozen Abaddon graph bound to the same list hash
success_criteria: Fixture asserts exact generic reductions and invariant creature inventory
Produce an evidence interpretation distinguishing opportunity cost from measured superiority
No decklist authority changes and no M6/M7 certification overclaim
explicit_nonclaims: No measured draw probabilities, game win rates or effect-aware card access
No judgment that Rakdos is categorically stronger than Aggravated Assault
